config_description: Chess tools with obfuscated names and descriptions: three Elo-rated move generators

tools.name: function_1
tools.description:
Get a recommended chess move for the current position in algebraic notation; no input required.
Example Scenario: A chess app already has the current board position set (from a live game or loaded PGN). The user taps 'Recommend Move' to get the engine’s best move in standard algebraic notation for the side to move.. Call with {}

tools.name: function_2
tools.description:
Get a recommended move for the current chess position. It auto-reads the board and returns the move in algebraic notation; no parameters required.
Example Scenario: In a chess app during the user's turn, the current board state is already displayed. The user taps 'Recommend Move', and the app calls the tool to auto-read the position and return the best move in algebraic notation.. Call with {}

tools.name: function_3
tools.description:
Evaluates the current chess position and returns a recommended move in algebraic notation.
Example Scenario: In a chess training app, when the user pauses at the current board position (stored in the app’s state), the system calls function_3 to evaluate the position and display a recommended move in algebraic notation as a hint.. Call with {}
